description: Schedule the Claude agent turn and expose public control, stable state, and state flux files; on_start / on_stop fire the after_start / after_stop hooks (lib/tools/agent/hook_fire); on_before_run / on_after_run fire before_run / after_run around each turn (aos-hook), only while the flag file is in the stack (hook_before_run.flag, hook_after_run.flag).
